spec.description: MapManagementMapConfigSpec defines the desired state of MapManagementMapConfig

description.description: Optional. The description of this MapConfig, as specified by the user.

displayName.description: Optional. The display name of this MapConfig, as specified by the user.

mapFeatures.description: Optional. The Map Features that apply to this Map Config.

poiBoostLevel.description: Optional. POI Boost level, where 0 denotes no boostings and negative values denotes de-boosting. Boosted POIs are shown at lower zoom than default and vice versa de-boosted. Currently supports 2 levels of boosting, so the level is clamped to [-2, 2]. If not specified, the POI density defined in the style sheet will be used if it exists. Otherwise, no POI density will be applied.

simpleFeatures.description: Optional. The visual feature to use for this map.

mapType.description: Optional. Represents the Map Type of the MapConfig. If this is unset, the default behavior is to use the raster map type.

projectRef.description: The project that this resource belongs to.

kind.description: The kind of the Project resource; optional but must be `Project` if provided.

resourceID.description: The MapManagementMapConfig name. If not given, the metadata.name will be used.
